captions.efficiency: Tag-and-probe efficiencies in data and simulation; error bars are statistical. Panels are ordered by increasing probe |eta| from left to right, then top to bottom: 0 < |eta| < 0.8, 0.8 < |eta| < 1.44, 1.44 < |eta| < 2.5.
captions.mass_fit_bin_00: Probe bin 0 < |eta| < 0.8, 5 < pT < 7 GeV. Panels are data pass, data fail, simulation pass, and simulation fail in reading order. The nominal data fit has chi2/ndf=1.913; the resulting scale factor is 0.8349 +/- 0.0460.

captions.scale_factor: Data-to-simulation scale factors with total uncertainties. The marker series correspond to the probe |eta| bins listed in the legend.
captions.scale_factor_heatmap: Two-dimensional scale-factor map; each cell shows the central value and total uncertainty.
